import ast,hashlib,json,math,subprocess,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import numpy as np
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'craft_v6_out'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
state=json.loads((out/'v62_resume_state.json').read_text()); probe=json.loads((out/'v61_probe.json').read_text()); prov=state['provenance']
assert state['status']=='probe_passed_review_required'
assert [s['stage'] for s in state['completed']]==['pretrain_s0','pretrain_s1','pretrain_s2','probe']
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',prov['freeze']],text=True).strip()==prov['freeze_commit']
source={}
for p,v in prov['files'].items():
 raw=(root/p).read_bytes(); frozen=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',prov['freeze']+':'+p])
 assert raw==frozen and sha(root/p)==v['working_sha256']==v['frozen_sha256']
 source[p]=sha(root/p)
assert len(source)==17
for p,h in prov['inputs'].items():assert sha(out/p)==h
assert sha(out/'v61_gate_v62.json')==prov['gate_sha256']
assert sha(root/'scripts/resume_v62.py')==prov['launcher_sha256']
artifacts={}
for s in state['completed']:
 for p,h in s['artifacts'].items():
  assert sha(out/p)==h;artifacts[p]=h
assert probe['summary']['roster_ceiling']==json.loads((out/'v61_roster.json').read_text())
assert probe['world']==8150 and probe['lineage']==0 and set(probe['arms'])=={'M1','M2','M3','M4','R'}
# Execute only the frozen NumPy/Python world generator functions, never its torch imports or emulator classes.
tree=ast.parse((root/'ragnarok/environments/law_world.py').read_text())
safe=ast.Module(body=[n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef)],type_ignores=[])
ns={'np':np,'T_MAX':4,'BOTCH':-2,'INERT':-1}
exec(compile(safe,'audited_pure_law_functions','exec'),ns)
laws=ns['sample_laws'](31337);spec=ns['make_world'](8150,laws);goals=ns['goal_stream'](spec)
assert len(goals)==3
pre=json.loads((out/'v61_pre_s0.json').read_text());exercised={tuple(c) for c in pre['exercised']}
pairs=[(i,j) for i in range(spec['n_items']) for j in range(i+1,spec['n_items']) if not spec['decoy'][i] and not spec['decoy'][j] and spec['tier'][i]==spec['tier'][j]<4]
y=np.array([laws['Bond'][spec['el'][i],spec['el'][j]] for i,j in pairs])
ex=np.array([tuple(sorted((spec['el'][i],spec['el'][j]))) in exercised for i,j in pairs])
groups={'all':np.ones(len(pairs),bool),'exercised':ex,'unexercised':~ex}
denoms={k:dict(pairs=int(m.sum()),positive=int((m&y).sum()),negative=int((m&~y).sum())) for k,m in groups.items()}
for d in denoms.values():d['rank_comparisons']=d['positive']*d['negative']
# Reconstruct exactly the AUC's empty-store input rows for each selected pair, from public attrs/own inventory only.
n=spec['n_items'];x=np.zeros((len(pairs),28,32),dtype=np.float32)
for a,(i,j) in enumerate(pairs):x[a,[i,j],0]=1
x[:,:n,5]=[k=='R' for k in spec['kind']];x[:,:n,6]=1;x[:,:,7]=x[:,:,5]
for i in range(n):
 x[:,i,8+spec['el'][i]]=1;x[:,i,22]=spec['tier'][i]/4;x[:,i,23]=spec['gate'][i]/2
 x[:,i,28]=np.float32(1)-((n-1)-(2-x[:,i,0])).astype(np.float32)/np.float32(n-1)
x[:,:n,29]=1;x[:,spec['target'],31]=1
ctx=x[:,:n,:].sum(axis=1)/np.float32(n)
xi=np.stack([x[k,i] for k,(i,j) in enumerate(pairs)])
xj=np.stack([x[k,j] for k,(i,j) in enumerate(pairs)])
cells=np.concatenate([xi+xj,xi*xj,ctx,np.zeros((len(pairs),16+5+1),np.float32)],axis=1)
assert cells.shape==(45,118)
shapes=[(128,118),(128,),(128,128),(128,),(1,128),(1,),(3,128),(3,),(14,128),(14,)]
keys=['enc.0.weight','enc.0.bias','enc.2.weight','enc.2.bias','score.weight','score.bias','out3.weight','out3.bias','outel.weight','outel.bias']
auc_recomputed={}
checkpoints={}
for name in ('M1','M2','M3','M4'):
 path=out/('v61_pre_s0_'+name+'.pt')
 with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
  assert z.testzip() is None
  prefix=next(p.rsplit('/',1)[0] for p in z.namelist() if p.endswith('/data.pkl'))
  weights={}
  for j,(key,shape) in enumerate(zip(keys,shapes)):
   weights[key]=np.frombuffer(z.read(prefix+'/data/'+str(j)),dtype='<f4').reshape(shape)
   assert np.isfinite(weights[key]).all()
 h=np.maximum(0,cells@weights['enc.0.weight'].T+weights['enc.0.bias'])
 h=np.maximum(0,h@weights['enc.2.weight'].T+weights['enc.2.bias'])
 o=h@weights['out3.weight'].T+weights['out3.bias']
 q=np.exp(o-o.max(axis=1,keepdims=True));p=1-q[:,0]/q.sum(axis=1)
 a={}
 for k,m in groups.items():
  pos,neg=p[m&y],p[m&~y];a[k]=float((pos[:,None]>neg[None,:]).mean()+.5*(pos[:,None]==neg[None,:]).mean())
  assert math.isclose(a[k],probe['arms'][name]['auc'][k],abs_tol=1e-12),(name,k,a[k],probe['arms'][name]['auc'][k])
 auc_recomputed[name]=a
 checkpoints[name]=dict(path=path.name,sha256=sha(path),size_bytes=path.stat().st_size,float32_values=sum(w.size for w in weights.values()),zip_crc_valid=True)
arms={}
for name,v in probe['arms'].items():
 assert type(v['n']) is int and 0<v['n']<=768 and math.isfinite(v['lawful']) and 0<=v['lawful']<=1
 count=round(v['n']*v['lawful']);assert math.isclose(count,v['n']*v['lawful'],abs_tol=1e-10)
 assert v['auc']['n_ex']==denoms['exercised']['pairs'] and v['auc']['n_unex']==denoms['unexercised']['pairs']
 for k,d in denoms.items():
  a=v['auc'][k];assert math.isfinite(a) and 0<=a<=1
  twice=2*a*d['rank_comparisons'];assert math.isclose(twice,round(twice),abs_tol=1e-10)
 arms[name]=dict(lawful_count=count,observed_first_proposals=v['n'],maximum_first_proposals=768,no_recorded_first_proposal=768-v['n'],lawfulness=v['lawful'],auc=v['auc'])
m,r=arms['M4'],arms['R'];pool=(m['lawful_count']+r['lawful_count'])/(m['observed_first_proposals']+r['observed_first_proposals'])
se=math.sqrt(pool*(1-pool)*(1/m['observed_first_proposals']+1/r['observed_first_proposals']))
delta=m['lawfulness']-r['lawfulness'];passed=delta>=3*se
assert math.isclose(se,probe['summary']['se'],abs_tol=1e-15) and probe['summary']['passed'] is passed
probe_start=22823.7297333;probe_duration=state['elapsed_seconds']-probe_start
spent_before_controller=6.7*3600+16124+137.15
spent=spent_before_controller+state['elapsed_seconds']
future=87*(11832/18)
result=dict(kind='v62_probe_independent_review',recorded_at_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 reviewer='Codex independent subagent /root/audit_gate_v62',passed=passed,probe_sha256=sha(out/'v61_probe.json'),
 controller_state_sha256=sha(out/'v62_resume_state.json'),freeze_commit=prov['freeze_commit'],
 source_sha256=source,input_sha256=prov['inputs'],gate_sha256=prov['gate_sha256'],launcher_sha256=prov['launcher_sha256'],
 completed_artifact_sha256=artifacts,controller_status=state['status'],controller_pid=state['controller_pid'],
 world=8150,lineage=0,goals=goals,num_envs=64,episodes_per_goal=4,arms=arms,
 decision=dict(rule='r(M4)-r(R) >= 3*sqrt(pooled*(1-pooled)*(1/n_M4+1/n_R))',pooled=pool,delta=delta,se=se,threshold_3se=3*se,delta_over_se=delta/se,margin_above_3se=delta-3*se),
 auc_pair_denominators=denoms,auc_recomputed_numpy_from_M_checkpoints=auc_recomputed,checkpoints=checkpoints,
 budget=dict(hard_ceiling_hours=42,previous_v61_seconds=6.7*3600,v62_gate_seconds=16124,precheck_seconds=137.15,
 controller_elapsed_seconds=state['elapsed_seconds'],pretrain_actual_seconds=probe_start,probe_actual_controller_seconds=probe_duration,
 probe_allowance_replaced_seconds=1800,actual_spent_seconds=spent,actual_spent_hours=spent/3600,actual_remaining_seconds=42*3600-spent,
 future_81_confirm_plus_6_Gprime_goal_runs_seconds=future,t6_seconds=11832/18,projected_total_hours=(spent+future)/3600,
 projected_margin_hours=42-(spent+future)/3600,B_test=6,N=9,Gprime_units=2),
 method=['Pure frozen world-generator functions extracted with ast; no torch imports, emulator, or training.',

 'All 17 frozen sources byte-identical to git freeze; both inputs, gate, launcher and all 16 completed artifacts equal controller hashes.'],
 limits=['First-proposal trial-level actions and RNG traces are not retained; lawful integer counts are reconstructed from stored n and rates, not independently rerun.',

 'Current source/hash equality and controller prelaunch checks establish provenance to the available record; no signed runtime attestation is claimed.'],
